verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοὺς λόγους τούτους μετῆρεν ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὰ ὅρια τῆς Ἰουδαίας πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto hote etelesen ho Iēsous tous logous toutous metēren apo tēs Galilaias kai ēlthen eis ta horia tēs Ioudaias peran tou Iordanou
verses.literal: When Jesus had finished saying these things . . . . . . He left . . . Galilee and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Tendo Jesus dito estas palavras, deixou a Galileia e foi para os confins da Judeia, além do Jordão.

verses.original: καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: kai ēkolouthēsan autō ochloi polloi kai etherapeusen autous ekei
verses.literal: Large crowds followed Him and He healed them there
verses.literalPt: Seguiram-no grandes multidões, e ali curou os doentes.

verses.original: Καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ Φαρισαῖοι πειράζοντες αὐτὸν καὶ λέγοντες Εἰ ἔξεστιν ἀνθρώπῳ ἀπολῦσαι τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ κατὰ πᾶσαν αἰτίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai prosēlthon autō Pharisaioi peirazontes auton kai legontes Ei exestin anthrōpō apolysai tēn gynaika autou kata pasan aitian
verses.literal: Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason
verses.literalPt: Vieram a ele alguns fariseus e o experimentaram, perguntando: É lícito a um homem repudiar sua mulher por qualquer causa?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε ὅτι ὁ κτίσας ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς Ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἐποίησεν αὐτοὺς
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen Ouk anegnōte hoti ho ktisas ap’ archēs Arsen kai thēly epoiēsen autous
verses.literal: Jesus answered Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator made them male and female
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Jesus: Não tendes lido que o Criador, desde o princípio, os fez homem e mulher

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν Ἕνεκα τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ κολληθήσεται τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν
verses.transliteration: kai eipen Heneka toutou kataleipsei anthrōpos ton patera kai tēn mētera kai kollēthēsetai tē gynaiki autou kai esontai hoi dyo eis sarka mian
verses.literal: and said For this reason . . . a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife and the two will become . . . one flesh
verses.literalPt: e disse: Por esta razão o homem deixará seu pai e sua mãe e se unirá a sua mulher, e os dois se tornarão uma só carne?

verses.original: ὥστε οὐκέτι εἰσὶν δύο ἀλλὰ σὰρξ μία ὃ οὖν ὁ Θεὸς συνέζευξεν ἄνθρωπος μὴ χωριζέτω
verses.transliteration: hōste ouketi eisin dyo alla sarx mia ho oun ho Theos synezeuxen anthrōpos mē chōrizetō
verses.literal: So they are no longer two but one flesh Therefore what God has joined together let man not separate
verses.literalPt: Assim já não são dois, mas uma só carne. Portanto, o que Deus ajuntou, não o separe o homem.

verses.original: Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Τί οὖν Μωϋσῆς ἐνετείλατο δοῦναι βιβλίον ἀποστασίου καὶ ἀπολῦσαι αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: Legousin autō Ti oun Mōusēs eneteilato dounai biblion apostasiou kai apolysai autēn
verses.literal: Why then they asked did Moses order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away . . .
verses.literalPt: Replicaram-lhe: Por que, então, mandou Moisés dar carta de divórcio e repudiar a mulher?

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὅτι Μωϋσῆς πρὸς τὴν σκληροκαρδίαν ὑμῶν ἐπέτρεψεν ὑμῖν ἀπολῦσαι τὰς γυναῖκας ὑμῶν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς δὲ οὐ γέγονεν οὕτως
verses.transliteration: Legei autois Hoti Mōusēs pros tēn sklērokardian hymōn epetrepsen hymin apolysai tas gynaikas hymōn ap’ archēs de ou gegonen houtōs
verses.literal: Jesus replied - Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of your hardness of heart But it was not this way from the beginning
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Jesus: Por causa da dureza do vosso coração é que Moisés vos permitiu repudiar vossas mulheres, mas não foi assim desde o princípio.

verses.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ μὴ ἐπὶ πορνείᾳ καὶ γαμήσῃ ἄλλην μοιχᾶται
verses.transliteration: legō de hymin hoti hos an apolysē tēn gynaika autou mē epi porneia kai gamēsē allēn moichatai
verses.literal: Now I tell you that whoever . . . divorces his wife except for sexual immorality and marries another woman commits adultery
verses.literalPt: Eu vos digo que aquele que repudiar sua mulher, exceto por infidelidade, e casar com outra comete adultério.

verses.original: Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταί αὐτοῦ Εἰ οὕτως ἐστὶν ἡ αἰτία τοῦ ἀνθρώπου μετὰ τῆς γυναικός οὐ συμφέρει γαμῆσαι
verses.transliteration: Legousin autō hoi mathētai autou Ei houtōs estin hē aitia tou anthrōpou meta tēs gynaikos ou sympherei gamēsai
verses.literal: His disciples said to Him If this is the case between a man and his wife it is better not to marry
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe os discípulos: Se tal é a condição de um homem para com sua mulher, não convém casar.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐ πάντες χωροῦσιν τὸν λόγον τοῦτον ἀλλ’ οἷς δέδοται
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autois Ou pantes chōrousin ton logon touton all’ hois dedotai
verses.literal: Not everyone can accept this word - He replied . . . but only those to whom it has been given
verses.literalPt: Mas ele respondeu: Nem todos podem aceitar esse conceito, mas somente aqueles a quem é dado.

verses.original: εἰσὶν γὰρ εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς ἐγεννήθησαν οὕτως καὶ εἰσὶν εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες εὐνουχίσθησαν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ εἰσὶν εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες εὐνούχισαν ἑαυτοὺς διὰ τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν ὁ δυνάμενος χωρεῖν χωρείτω
verses.transliteration: eisin gar eunouchoi hoitines ek koilias mētros egennēthēsan houtōs kai eisin eunouchoi hoitines eunouchisthēsan hypo tōn anthrōpōn kai eisin eunouchoi hoitines eunouchisan heautous dia tēn basileian tōn ouranōn ho dynamenos chōrein chōreitō
verses.literal: For there are eunuchs who were born that way - others were made that way by men and still others live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven The one who can accept this should accept it
verses.literalPt: Pois há eunucos, que nasceram assim; há outros a quem os homens fizeram tais; e outros há que se fizeram eunucos por causa do reino dos céus. Quem pode aceitar isso, aceite-o.

verses.original: Τότε προσηνέχθησαν αὐτῷ παιδία ἵνα τὰς χεῖρας ἐπιθῇ αὐτοῖς καὶ προσεύξηται οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμησαν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Tote prosēnechthēsan autō paidia hina tas cheiras epithē autois kai proseuxētai hoi de mathētai epetimēsan autois
verses.literal: Then little children were brought to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them and pray for them And the disciples rebuked those who brought them
verses.literalPt: Então lhe trouxeram alguns meninos, para que lhes impusesse as mãos e orasse por eles; e os discípulos repreenderam aos que os trouxeram.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία καὶ μὴ κωλύετε αὐτὰ ἐλθεῖν πρός με τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: ho de Iēsous eipen Aphete ta paidia kai mē kōlyete auta elthein pros me tōn gar toioutōn estin hē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: But Jesus said Let the little children come to Me and do not hinder them For the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these
verses.literalPt: Jesus, porém, disse: Deixai os meninos e não os impeçais de virem a mim; porque dos tais é o reino dos céus.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῖς ἐπορεύθη ἐκεῖθεν
verses.transliteration: kai epitheis tas cheiras autois eporeuthē ekeithen
verses.literal: And after He had placed His hands on them He went on from there
verses.literalPt: Depois de lhes impor as mãos, partiu dali.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ εἷς προσελθὼν αὐτῷ εἶπεν Διδάσκαλε τί ἀγαθὸν ποιήσω ἵνα σχῶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: Kai idou heis proselthōn autō eipen Didaskale ti agathon poiēsō hina schō zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: Just then . . . a man came up to Jesus and inquired Teacher what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life
verses.literalPt: Chegou um moço e perguntou-lhe: Mestre, que coisa boa farei para ter a vida eterna?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τί με ἐρωτᾷς περὶ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ εἷς ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαθός εἰ δὲ θέλεις εἰς τὴν ζωὴν εἰσελθεῖν τήρησον τὰς ἐντολάς
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autō Ti me erōtas peri tou agathou heis estin ho agathos ei de theleis eis tēn zōēn eiselthein tērēson tas entolas
verses.literal: Why do you ask Me about what is good - Jesus replied . . . There is only One who is good If you want to enter . . . life keep the commandments
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Por que me perguntas sobre o que é bom? Um há que é bom; mas, se queres entrar na vida, guarda os mandamentos.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Ποίας Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Τὸ Οὐ φονεύσεις Οὐ μοιχεύσεις Οὐ κλέψεις Οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις
verses.transliteration: Legei autō Poias Ho de Iēsous eipen To Ou phoneuseis Ou moicheuseis Ou klepseis Ou pseudomartyrēseis
verses.literal: Which ones the man asked . . . - Jesus answered Do not murder do not commit adultery do not steal do not bear false witness
verses.literalPt: Ele inquiriu: Quais? Respondeu Jesus: Não matarás, não adulterarás, não furtarás, não dirás falso testemunho,

verses.original: Τίμα τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν
verses.transliteration: Tima ton patera kai tēn mētera kai Agapēseis ton plēsion sou hōs seauton
verses.literal: honor your father and mother and love your neighbor as yourself
verses.literalPt: honra a teu pai e a tua mãe e amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ νεανίσκος Ταῦτα πάντα ἐφύλαξα τί ἔτι ὑστερῶ
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ho neaniskos Tauta panta ephylaxa ti eti hysterō
verses.literal: All these I have kept said the young man . . . What do I still lack
verses.literalPt: Replicou-lhe o moço: Tudo isso tenho guardado; que me falta ainda?

verses.original: Ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἰ θέλεις τέλειος εἶναι ὕπαγε πώλησόν σου τὰ ὑπάρχοντα καὶ δὸς τοῖς πτωχοῖς καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι
verses.transliteration: Ephē autō ho Iēsous Ei theleis teleios einai hypage pōlēson sou ta hyparchonta kai dos tois ptōchois kai hexeis thēsauron en ouranois kai deuro akolouthei moi
verses.literal: Jesus told him If you want to be perfect go sell your possessions and give to the poor and you will have treasure in heaven Then come follow Me
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Se queres ser perfeito, vai vender tudo o que tens, e dá-o aos pobres, e terás um tesouro nos céus; depois, vem seguir-me.

verses.original: Ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ νεανίσκος τὸν λόγον τοῦτον ἀπῆλθεν λυπούμενος ἦν γὰρ ἔχων κτήματα πολλά
verses.transliteration: Akousas de ho neaniskos ton logon touton apēlthen lypoumenos ēn gar echōn ktēmata polla
verses.literal: When the young man heard this - he went away in sorrow because he had great wealth
verses.literalPt: O moço, porém, ouvindo esses preceitos, retirou-se triste, porque tinha muitos bens.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πλούσιος δυσκόλως εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous eipen tois mathētais autou Amēn legō hymin hoti plousios dyskolōs eiseleusetai eis tēn basileian tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to His disciples Truly I tell you it is hard for a rich man to enter . . . the kingdom of heaven
verses.literalPt: Jesus declarou a seus discípulos: Em verdade vos digo que um rico dificilmente entrará no reino dos céus.

verses.original: πάλιν δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν εὐκοπώτερόν ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ τρυπήματος ῥαφίδος εἰσελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: palin de legō hymin eukopōteron estin kamēlon dia trypēmatos rhaphidos eiselthein ē plousion eiselthein eis tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: Again I tell you it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter . . . the kingdom of God
verses.literalPt: Também vos digo que mais fácil é passar um camelo pelo fundo de uma agulha do que entrar um rico no reino de Deus.

verses.original: Ἀκούσαντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο σφόδρα λέγοντες Τίς ἄρα δύναται σωθῆναι
verses.transliteration: Akousantes de hoi mathētai exeplēssonto sphodra legontes Tis ara dynatai sōthēnai
verses.literal: When the disciples heard this they were greatly astonished and asked Who then can be saved
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo isso, ficaram os discípulos muito admirados e perguntaram: Quem pode, porventura, ser salvo?

verses.original: Ἐμβλέψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Παρὰ ἀνθρώποις τοῦτο ἀδύνατόν ἐστιν παρὰ δὲ Θεῷ πάντα δυνατά
verses.transliteration: Emblepsas de ho Iēsous eipen autois Para anthrōpois touto adynaton estin para de Theō panta dynata
verses.literal: Jesus looked at them and said . . . With man this is impossible but with God all things are possible
verses.literalPt: Jesus, volvendo os olhos para eles, respondeu: Aos homens é isso impossível, mas a Deus tudo é possível.

verses.original: Τότε ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν πάντα καὶ ἠκολουθήσαμέν σοι τί ἄρα ἔσται ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Tote apokritheis ho Petros eipen autō Idou hēmeis aphēkamen panta kai ēkolouthēsamen soi ti ara estai hēmin
verses.literal: Look - Peter replied . . . . . . we have left everything to follow You What then will there be for us
verses.literalPt: Então Pedro lhe disse: E nós, que deixamos tudo e te seguimos, que receberemos?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὑμεῖς οἱ ἀκολουθήσαντές μοι ἐν τῇ παλινγενεσίᾳ ὅταν καθίσῃ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης αὐτοῦ καθήσεσθε καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐπὶ δώδεκα θρόνους κρίνοντες τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous eipen autois Amēn legō hymin hoti hymeis hoi akolouthēsantes moi en tē palingenesia hotan kathisē ho Huios tou anthrōpou epi thronou doxēs autou kathēsesthe kai hymeis epi dōdeka thronous krinontes tas dōdeka phylas tou Israēl
verses.literal: Jesus said to them Truly I tell you in the renewal of all things when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Em verdade vos digo que vós que me seguistes, quando, na regeneração, o Filho do Homem se assentar no trono da sua glória, sentar-vos-eis também em doze tronos, para julgardes as doze tribos de Israel.

verses.original: καὶ πᾶς ὅστις ἀφῆκεν οἰκίας ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ ἀδελφὰς ἢ πατέρα ἢ μητέρα ἢ γυναῖκα ἢ τέκνα ἢ ἀγροὺς ἕνεκεν τοῦ μου ὀνόματός ἑκατονταπλασίονα λήμψεται καὶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσει
verses.transliteration: kai pas hostis aphēken oikias ē adelphous ē adelphas ē patera ē mētera ē gynaika ē tekna ē agrous heneken tou mou onomatos hekatontaplasiona lēmpsetai kai zōēn aiōnion klēronomēsei
verses.literal: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life
verses.literalPt: Todo o que tem deixado casas, irmãos, irmãs, pai, mãe, filhos ou terras por causa do meu nome receberá muitas vezes mais e herdará a vida eterna.

verses.original: Πολλοὶ δὲ ἔσονται πρῶτοι ἔσχατοι καὶ ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι
verses.transliteration: Polloi de esontai prōtoi eschatoi kai eschatoi prōtoi
verses.literal: But many who are first will be last and the last will be first
verses.literalPt: Porém muitos que são primeiros serão os últimos; e muitos que são últimos serão os primeiros.
